graph.use_when: Named nodes with relationships where position carries meaning: request paths, data flow, dependency maps. Under 12 nodes.
graph.avoid_when: Linear steps (use steps or pipeline). Strict hierarchy (use tree or org_chart). A single row of peers (use card_grid).

rules.say: Past 6 nodes, set row (and column) on every node so the layout is tiered instead of auto-placed. Auto layout overlaps at this size.
More than 14 nodes will not read on one screen. Split into two graphs or group nodes and drop detail text.
Node width above 160 overlaps the 172px slot in tiered mode. Shorten the label instead.
Node detail wraps to 4 lines then truncates. Keep each detail under about 24 words.
A graph with no edges is a card_grid. Add edges or switch component.

pipeline.use_when: Inputs flow through 2 to 4 stages to outputs, each stage owning a few named capabilities. Optional context strip below.
pipeline.avoid_when: One stage (use a box or steps). More than 4 stages (use a graph with rows, or two pipelines).

rules.say: Pipelines wider than 4 stages compress each stage below readable width. Split or switch to a tiered graph.

Stages stack vertically inside the height (default 400): about 48px per stage plus 42px per capability. Three stages fit about 5 capabilities total at the default; set height (9 capabilities need about 560) or trim.
Stages stack vertically inside the height (default 400): about 48px per stage plus 42px per capability. Two stages fit about 7 capabilities total at the default; set height or trim.
Stages stack vertically inside the height (default 400): about 48px per stage plus 42px per capability. Four or more stages need an explicit height (about 48 per stage plus 42 per capability).
A height under 400 with more than 6 capabilities clips the bottom stage. Raise height to about 48 per stage plus 42 per capability.
With a context strip the stages get 78% of the height. At the default 400 that fits about 4 capabilities total; set height to about 1.3 times the stacked size.
Five capabilities per stage is the ceiling before rows truncate at the default height. Trim, dim the minor ones, or raise height.
Stage detail is a tag line. Keep it under 8 words.
A pipeline needs inputs or outputs to show what flows through it.

grid.use_when: Diagram-style layouts: boxes in explicit cells, connectors between rows, bands made of a box holding another grid.
grid.avoid_when: Equal-width text columns (use columns). Cards of peers (use card_grid). Metrics (use stat_grid).

rules.say: More than 4 grid columns squeezes box text. Use 2 to 4 and nest a grid inside a box for a wider band.
A grid with more than 16 children is hard to scan. Split into sections or collapse detail into a table.

box.use_when: A labelled panel: title left, uppercase tag right, short markdown body, optional nested components. The unit inside grid diagrams.
box.avoid_when: Warnings or notes in prose flow (use callout). Long text (use section with markdown).

rules.say: Box bodies over about 120 words stop reading as a panel. Move the prose into a markdown block and keep the box to a summary.
Box titles are labels. Keep them under 8 words.
tag renders uppercase and right-aligned. One to three words.

connector.use_when: A short grid row between two boxes showing direction, with a label on the line.
connector.avoid_when: Anything outside a grid. It fills its cell and has no meaning on its own.

rules.say: Connector labels sit on a thin line. Keep them under 7 words.

sequence.use_when: Walking a reader through a diagram step by step: highlight a few ids per step with a one-line note.
sequence.avoid_when: Pages with no target diagram. Static documents meant for print (it is hidden in export).

rules.say: More than 8 steps loses the reader. Merge steps or split the walkthrough.
Step notes are captions. Keep each under 40 words.
Highlighting more than 4 ids in one step dims almost nothing. Split the step.

markdown.use_when: Prose, lists, short tables. The default when nothing structured fits.
markdown.avoid_when: Anything that has a component: metrics (stat_grid), comparisons (table), steps (steps), warnings (callout).

rules.say: Over about 400 words in one markdown block. Split into sections with headings, or pull structure into a table, steps, or boxes.

callout.use_when: One point the reader must not miss: a caveat, a decision, a rule of thumb. One or two sentences.
callout.avoid_when: Body copy. More than two callouts in a row.

rules.say: Callouts over about 80 words stop reading as a highlight. Trim to the point, move the rest to markdown.

table.use_when: Rows that share the same fields. Comparisons, inventories, mappings.
table.avoid_when: One row (use a definition_list or stat_grid). Cells that need paragraphs (use markdown with headings).

rules.say: More than 6 columns wraps every cell. Drop columns or split into two tables.
Over 40 rows, set filterable: true so readers can search.

chart.use_when: One series over a handful of categories or a time series. Headline numbers belong in stat_grid.
chart.avoid_when: More than 10 categories (use a table). Two unrelated metrics (use two charts).

rules.say: More than 10 points per series crowds the labels. Group the tail or switch to a table.
More than 4 series is unreadable in one chart. Split it.

stat_grid.use_when: Two to six headline metrics, each with a label, a value, and a one-line detail.
stat_grid.avoid_when: Long labels or paragraphs (use table). A single number (use markdown or callout).

rules.say: More than 8 stats is a table. Pick the six that matter.
Stat detail is one short line. Keep it under 12 words.

card_grid.use_when: Peer items with a title, a status badge, a line of description, and links: customers, projects, tools.
card_grid.avoid_when: Items with relationships between them (use graph). Items with many fields (use table).

rules.say: More than 12 cards is a directory. Use a filterable table or split by section.
Card descriptions are one or two lines. Keep them under 30 words.

tree.use_when: Hierarchical work with status per node: plans, rollouts, checklists with sub-items.
tree.avoid_when: Flat lists (use steps or markdown). Org structure (use org_chart).

rules.say: More than 12 top-level nodes; group them under parents and set default_depth so the tree opens collapsed.

timeline.use_when: Ordered milestones with a status each.
timeline.avoid_when: Dated events with descriptions (use event_timeline). Process steps (use steps).

rules.say: More than 10 milestones; consolidate or switch to event_timeline grouped by month.

section.use_when: Grouping a page into scannable chunks with a heading. In presentation mode each top-level section is a slide.
section.avoid_when: Wrapping a single component with no heading.

rules.say: A section with more than 12 components is a page. Split it.

columns.use_when: Two or three equal-width text columns.
columns.avoid_when: Boxes or diagram cells (use grid). More than three columns.

rules.say: More than 4 columns collapses on any normal width. Use grid for diagrams or a table for data.
